第9章暗河融念，金痕满九道

金光散尽时，苏余发现自己站在一座巨大的地下溶洞之中。

溶洞顶部开了一个天窗，月光倾泻而下，照在正中央一汪墨绿色的水潭上。

水潭圆形，直径约莫十丈，潭水不流动也不溢出，平静如镜。

水潭正中央悬浮着一具通体漆黑的石棺，棺盖上刻满密密麻麻的金色符文——与他识海中时王碑的光芒如出一辙。

是鬼哭崖下的时族禁制感应到了他身上的血脉，在他即将跳崖的瞬间将他传送进了禁制核心。

苏余环顾四周。

溶洞三面是光滑如镜的岩壁，一面是他刚才被传送进来的方向——那里没有门，只有一面刻满符文的石壁。

他走上前推了推，纹丝不动。

出不去了。

他定了定神，走到水潭边缘。

潭边立着一块残碑，上面刻着模糊的字迹：

“大夏历九千四百二十一年，时族第十八代守墓人苏玄，途径此地，感鬼哭崖阴气汇聚，恐千年后尸王出世祸害苍生，遂以自身时痕为引，布下时族禁制镇压尸王千年。

千年之内禁制不破。

千年之后，自有后人来解。”

又是苏玄。

他的祖宗，时族第十八代守墓人，不仅留下时王传承，还在这鬼哭崖下布过禁制镇压尸王。

鬼哭崖之所以是禁地，之所以连修士都不敢进，正是因为这道时族禁制——千年来无人能破，外围的阴气和恐怖传说都是禁制的副产物。

那句“自有后人来解”——苏余明白了，苏玄等的后人，就是时族血脉的继承者，也就是他。

但真正让他心头一震的，是石棺中传来的共鸣。

那种感觉和当初在矿洞接触命魂碑时如出一辙，却更加强烈——识海中的时王碑在疯狂震动，像是失散多年的亲人终于重逢。

棺材里有苏玄留给后人的东西。

苏余没有犹豫。

他踏入潭水，一步步走向石棺。

潭水冰凉刺骨，没过膝盖、腰、胸口。

越靠近石棺共鸣感越强烈，胸膛上的七道黑痕开始发烫，两道金痕微弱发光抵抗着灼痛。

他伸出手，按在棺盖上。

手掌触碰石棺的刹那，七道黑痕同时爆发炽烈黑光。

一股庞大而不可抗拒的力量从石棺中涌出，顺着手臂冲入体内。

苏余眼前一黑，失去了意识。

坠入一片虚空。

黑暗中悬浮着巨大的时王碑，碑上燃烧着黑色火焰。

火焰中一个身影缓缓走出——老人，须发皆白，身形虚幻，破旧青色道袍，金色眼睛没有瞳孔。

与苏玄残魂一模一样，却又完全不同。

苏玄残魂温暖，带着长辈的欣慰；而眼前这个，眼中没有温度，只有饥饿。

“你终于来了，我的后人。”

声音沙哑如砂石，“我在这里等了你一千年。”

苏余手按刀柄：“你不是苏玄。”

“我是苏玄。

只不过不是你在矿洞里见到的善念——那是善念，而我是恶念。

善念传你时王碑，恶念传你渡劫之法。

善念希望你能活下去，重振时族。

而恶念——”

他停在苏余面前，金色眼眸倒映着苏余的身影，“只想向天道复仇。”

Chapter 9 The dark river merges with thoughts, and there are nine golden traces

When the golden light dissipated, Su Yu found himself standing in a huge underground cave.

A skylight was opened at the top of the cave, and the moonlight poured down, illuminating a dark green pool in the center.

The pool is round in shape, about ten feet in diameter. The water in the pool does not flow or overflow, and is as calm as a mirror.

There was a dark stone coffin suspended in the center of the pool. The lid of the coffin was densely engraved with golden runes - exactly the same as the light of the king's monument when he was in the sea.

It was the Time Clan's Restriction under the Guiwei Cliff that sensed his blood and teleported him into the Restriction Core at the moment he was about to jump off the cliff.

Su Yu looked around.

The three sides of the cave are smooth as mirror rock walls, and one side is from the direction he was teleported in just now - there is no door there, only a stone wall carved with runes.

He stepped forward and pushed, but it didn't move at all.

Can't get out.

He calmed down and walked to the edge of the pool.

There is a broken stele standing by the pool, with vague writing on it:

"In the 9421st year of the Great Xia Calendar, Su Xuan, the 18th generation gravekeeper of the Shi Clan, passed by this place and sensed the gathering of Yin Qi on the Ghost Weeping Cliff. He was afraid that the Corpse King would be born a thousand years later and harm the common people, so he used his own time marks as a guide to impose a ban on the Shi Clan to suppress the Corpse King for a thousand years.

The ban will not be broken within a thousand years.

Thousands of years later, future generations will figure it out."

It's Su Xuan again.

His ancestor, the 18th generation gravekeeper of the Shi clan, not only left the inheritance of the Shi King, but also placed a ban under the Ghost Weeping Cliff to suppress the Corpse King.

The reason why Guiwei Cliff is a forbidden area, and why even the monks dare not enter, is precisely because of this Time Clan prohibition - no one has been able to break it for thousands of years, and the surrounding Yin Qi and terrifying legends are all by-products of the prohibition.

That sentence "it will be up to the descendants to explain it" - Su Yu understood that the descendants of Su Xuan and others were the heirs of the Shi clan's bloodline, that is, him.

But what really shocked him was the resonance coming from the sarcophagus.

The feeling was exactly the same as when he came into contact with the Life Soul Monument in the mine, but it was even stronger - the Shi Wang Monument in the sea of ​​consciousness was shaking crazily, as if long-lost relatives were finally reunited.

There are things in the coffin that Su Xuan left for future generations.

Su Yu didn't hesitate.

He stepped into the pool and walked towards the sarcophagus step by step.

The water in the pool was freezing cold, reaching up to the knees, waist, and chest.

The closer he got to the sarcophagus, the stronger the resonance became. The seven black marks on his chest began to heat up, and the two golden marks glowed faintly to resist the burning pain.

He stretched out his hand and pressed it on the coffin lid.

The moment his palm touched the sarcophagus, seven black marks simultaneously erupted into blazing black light.

A huge and irresistible force surged out of the sarcophagus and rushed into the body along the arm.

Su Yu's vision went dark and he lost consciousness.

Falling into a void.

There is a huge Shiwang Monument suspended in the darkness, with black flames burning on it.

A figure slowly walked out of the flames - an old man, with white beard and hair, an illusory figure, a worn cyan robe, and golden eyes without pupils.

It is exactly the same as Su Xuan's remnant soul, but completely different.

Su Xuan's remnant soul was warm, with the comfort of an elder; but the one in front of him had no warmth in his eyes, only hunger.

"You are finally here, my descendant."

His voice was as hoarse as gravel, "I've been waiting for you here for a thousand years."

Su Yu pressed the handle of the knife: "You are not Su Xuan."

"I am Su Xuan.

It's just not the kind thoughts you see in the mines - those are good thoughts, and I have evil thoughts.

Good thoughts will be conveyed to you, and evil thoughts will be conveyed to you how to overcome the calamity.

Shan Nian hopes that you can survive and revive the Time Clan.

And evil thoughts——"

He stopped in front of Su Yu, his golden eyes reflected Su Yu's figure, "I just want to take revenge on Heaven."
